description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). Escrow a1 has a finalized open at block 110 and a finalized release whose block_number is -5. A negative integer is an integer, not a malformed value: it is outside the page's range (100 to 199), so it is never evidence, and because it is a finalized release naming a1, a1 is unverified.
